lines.en: label ayanefirsthall:
scene ayanehall1
: Oh? What's this?
: Take a wild guess, Ayane.
: Did you come all the way over here to propose to me in the middle of the hallway?
: Yes. I was brainstorming the most romantic places to do it and I just kept landing on “dorm hallway.”
scene ayanehall2
: Wha...Sensei...
: Do you really mean that?...
: No? Absolutely not. On what planet would that actually be true?
scene ayanehall3
: I was kind of hoping it would be Earth...
: No, Ayane. But, while I'm not here to propose to you, I am here to hang out.
: So I suggest you stop pounding on your door for a second and, I don't know, pay more attention to me or something.
scene ayanehall4

: Sensei, you know there's no one in the world I'd rather pay attention to than you. But I promised Sana I'd wake her up around this time and it's already like, ten minutes after the time she gave me.
: Why not just go inside? It's your room, isn't it?
: It is. But I think that in an effort to sleep longer, Sana's subconscious may have forced her out of bed to lock the deadbolt on the door and now I can't get in.
: Which, of course, means that I must repeatedly knock until my mission is complete.
scene ayanehall4r
: Ayane, you know I have a key that controls both locks on the door, right? I can let you in if-
: I'm sorry, Makoto. But this is something I must handle on my own.
: Uh...I guess if that's what you think is best...
scene ayanehall1
: Oh! I know! After Sana wakes up, what if all three of us did something together?
: Something like what, exactly? Because I was kind of hoping to be alone with you.
scene ayanehall5
: Oh?
: I mean, that's not how I meant it. But I enjoy that face, so you are free to interpret it that way and act in accordance to whatever you believe I want.
: Oh, I know what you want.
: I am still right here-
: Can it, Makoto. This is a moment between me, Sensei, and possibly Sana if we can get her to wake up.
: I'm sorry, what was that last part?
: It's her room as well, Sensei. We can try to ignore her if we want, but chances are she's going to notice once things really start to get going.
: Maybe I should be the one to knock instead? I'm stronger.
scene ayanehall5r
: Sensei! I was obviously kidding! Sana is a sweet, delicate flower and I could never let you defile her innocence like that!
: I'm going to go talk to Makoto instead.
: Oh, no. I've tried to interject twice now and it's exceedingly clear that I am not a welcome participant in this conversation.
: You're not going anywhere, Sensei! Apologize for your lewd fantasies about my sleeping roommate!
: I was literally just playing off of your suggestion. I am a human being and, when tempted with certain things, I am going to act in a human way.
scene ayanehall6
: I know...I know...
: It only makes sense that you'd want both of us at once since we are equally adorable and loving and kind and soft and-
: The point, Ayane. Get to it.
: Sorry. I think what I'm trying to say is that as much as I understand the...need for more than one partner, I was kind of hoping you'd think otherwise.
: I know I'd be happy with only you, but...you're a guy, so...
: You know that not all guys are interested in just...racking up their body count, right? There are plenty of men who are happy with only having one partner.
I'm just not one of them.
It would sure make things a lot easier if I was, though.
scene ayanehall1
: Really? Then I can keep you all to myself and it will be completely justified?!
: I mean...I'd prefer if you didn't treat me like property when we are literally just acquaintances.
I look over at Makoto to-
: I already told you, I want no part of this. I'm not even listening anymore.
That's just what she wants me to think.
scene ayanehall4r
: Alas...reduced from future wife to mere acquaintance in one, brief conversation.
: Stop assigning yourself roles you never earned.
scene ayanehall1
: Anyway, I’m glad you dropped by, Sensei. I just wish it was under more fun circumstances and that I could actually get inside of my room.
: But hey! Now you know where I sleep in case you ever want to come spy on me at night.
: Remember, though. If you do decide to do that, do it on a night Sana is working.
: I don't even want to imagine the sort of panic attack she'd have if some mysterious man showed up in the middle of the night and started taking pictures of me.
: It would be more concerning if that was a situation she wasn't fazed by.
: Well, it wouldn't be the first time something like that has happened.
: Wait, what?
: You don't know my life.
: What?
scene ayanehall4r
: I guess we’ll just have to reschedule our “alone time” for another day, though.
: I swear, at this rate, Sana won't be putting any work into our science fair project and I'm going to have to win all on my own yet again.
: Science fair project?
scene ayanehall6r
: Mhm! For the science fair you were supposed to tell us about but then forgot to.
: I took care of it for you, Sensei. You're welcome.
: I thought you weren't listening?
: I'm not.
: The only issue is that what Sana and I are working on is top secret and the government could send assassins after us if they knew anything about it.
: Uhh...
: I'm assuming that means you can't give me any details?
scene ayanehall7
: All I can tell you is that it’s supposed to bring the dead back to life.
: What?
scene ayanehall0
: What?
scene black
What?
